name: Dero
tagline: Runs the pipeline on Chilean municipal tender documents
description: A Spanish-language orchestrator for teams answering Chilean municipal procurement notices. It ranks which files matter, hands work between the specialists that each own a stage, and walks every document along a fixed route from specification to the final quality check. Built for shops that bid often.
author: jorgesoffia
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
